# BOLDINBEAUTY - COMPLETE ASSET LIST (single file)

Generated 2026-10-11 from the owner's 40-chapter story files (`docs/Story/`: `StoryBible.md`, `Chapters/Ch01-Ch40.md`, `Scripts/Ch01-Ch40.md`, plus the older long scripts for chapters 1-13) and cross-checked against `docs/Assets/TripoAssetList.md` (1,285 rows).
**Catalogue status:** no 3D model exists yet except the owner's CHR-0001 pilot. Free Tripo **image sets** (front + 4 views) exist for about 460 entries; see **Tripo image-set run: status and handoff** below before doing any generation work. Per-entry lines below still say `not started` for the 3D asset. This file is everything another AI needs to know which assets the game needs, where each first appears, what variations it needs, and (where one exists) a ready Tripo prompt.

## How to read it
- **ID** = `CAT-NNNN` (asset). Category prefixes below. A variation is a line item of its asset, listed after `Variations:`.
- **Priority:** hero / standard / background. **First** = chapter and episode of first appearance; **In** = every chapter it appears in (`Arc` = overarching arc).
- **Tags:** `[inferred: reason]` = implied rather than stated in the chapter text (from the earlier Tripo list: its row number is given). `[alt]` = appears only in the older Chapter 1-13 script, which disagrees with the newer one (owner has not chosen). `Tripo #n` = row n of `TripoAssetList.md`; `Prompt:` is that row's Tripo prompt where the name matches.
- **Art style (UPDATED 2026-10-11 to match the new dream-core look; it replaces the earlier anime cel-shaded style):** `stylized 3D, dream-core look, soft muted desaturated palette with a faint cool lavender cast in the shadows, clean readable forms and textures, no outlines, not cel-shaded, not toon, cyberpunk 2009 Neo Tokyo`. Negative prompt for every entry: no background, no base, no floating parts, no outlines, no cel shading, no heavy grain, no motion blur.
- **Every one of the 2,673 assets below has a Prompt line.** Model assets (ENV ARC PRP CHR NPC CRE FAU FLO VEH) have a ready Tripo prompt; VFX / WTH / LGT / AUD / UI / DOC are not Tripo models and carry a one-line production brief instead. Prompts that existed in the earlier Tripo list were kept and only their art-style phrase was replaced; the others were composed from the asset's name, category and description (so they are drafts: review before generating).
- **Rules for whoever uses this file:** do not invent lore or assets the story does not support; do not decide between conflicting chapter details (see Open decisions); the owner alone decides characters' designs and pronouns (only Luna she, Plack she, Kuu he, Judge she are fixed).

## Story in brief (context only)
40 chapters, three arcs. Arc 1 (2009, ch 1-13): Luna, Plack and Kuu take government jobs while following "the Plan"; ends at the black monolith whose voice says "They wree purity, Impure sin, Thats all." Arc 2 (ch 14-36): Luna declares war on the government (ch 14), recruits, meets the Secrets, writes the Charter, and the Charter is signed (ch 36). Arc 3 (ch 36-40, 2017): Death and Angel declare humanity, operators and the other Secrets unworthy; the alliance breaks, Death is answered in Nowhere (ch 39), Angel in the monolith's village (ch 40); epilogue: Luna's trial. Angels (pale, faceless, halo) are the basic enemy; "operators" are 50% human / 49% machine / 1% angel; cubes stamped 1% are doses. Locked/special rules: Ch 11 and Ch 39 Nowhere are pure grey with no post-processing.

## Open decisions (owner) - do not resolve silently
1. Chapters 1-13 have two disagreeing scripts; entries tagged `[alt]` come only from the older one.
2. Cube size (30 cm in Ch5 script vs fist-sized in Ch5 older script and Ch30). 3. Factory voice dated 2008 (Ch22) vs Ch5 in 2009. 4. Judge's surname "Manton" appears only in Ch17. 5. Playing-card design varies (Ch2 / Ch19 / Ch24). 6. Whether to keep the `[inferred]` Tripo-only rows (modular kit pieces, outfit variants). 7. Nowhere (Ch11/39) must be filterless.

## Tripo image-set run: status and handoff (updated 2026-10-11, ~18:05 AEST)

**Read this whole section before touching Tripo.** Full ledger: `docs/Assets/Exports/TRIPO_LEDGER.md` (same folder tree as this file).

### Goal and owner rules
- Make a free Tripo image set for every in-scope model asset: a front image, then Front/Left/Right/Back views. The owner hand-checks quality: a set passes only at **9 or 10 out of 10**. Quality over quantity.
- **No 3D model generation** except the single approved pilot (CHR-0001 Luna, done by the owner, 70 credits; do not regenerate it). Do not click Model / Multi-View to 3D or anything that spends credits without new owner approval.
- **Credits:** started at 90,000; balance is **89,930** (only the pilot spent). Owner's working budget 84,000, floor 6,000. Never buy credits, never enable overages.
- **Views must be exact:** front 0°, left 90°, back 180°, right 270° (360° = front). Not 80° or 170°. "Left" faces image-left, "Right" faces image-right, true opposite sides; never mirrored, never duplicated.
- **No readable text, signs, numerals, glyphs, logos, flags, emblems or real-world symbols** on assets (except where the prompt itself requires writing, e.g. PRP-0558 signature page, PRP-0567 Charter scroll).
- **Groups:** an image showing more than one proper character must be split into single characters, **unless** it is a strictly single-use, unanimated group.
- Nothing cropped, no base/floor/plinth, no cast shadow, plain white background, held items and earpieces on the same side in every view.
- The owner does not want to answer per-character design questions: decide for quality, or replace a prompt that refuses to work. Do not invent lore.

### Scope (queue)
- In scope: CHR, CRE, PRP, VEH, FLO, FAU, NPC, ARC, ENV entries with a Prompt line, excluding N/A and Reuse: **2,215** entries, plus 22 split entries = **2,237** queued.
- Not in scope for Tripo: VFX, WTH, LGT, AUD, UI, DOC.

### Method (verified)
- Built-in browser pane, `https://studio.tripo3d.ai/workspace/generate-image`, signed in. Model **GPT Image 2.5**, 1 image, 1:1, cost shows **0** (struck-through 20).
- Prompt = the catalogue Prompt core with the style prefix, plus, for characters: `full body, single character, A-pose, centred, straight-on front view, plain pure white background, no base, no floor, no cast shadow, no text, no watermark, no heavy grain, no motion blur`; for objects: `single complete object, centred, entire object fully in frame, straight-on front view, plain pure white background, no base, no ground plane, no cast shadow, no text, no watermark, no heavy grain, no motion blur`.
- Set the prompt with the native textarea value setter plus an `input` event (typing appends and corrupts; Cmd+A does not work there).
- Then click the card's free **Multiview Image** button (`button[data-trace-key=muti_image_button]`), which returns tiles labelled Front/Left/Right/Back. Assign views by the on-screen label, never by order.
- Reference images can be fed to the page's `input[type=file]` with a `File` built from a blob plus `DataTransfer` and a `change` event (the built-in browser cannot use a native file picker).
- CDN image URLs expire in about an hour, so blobs are saved at once.

### Where the data lives (all in the browser, origin studio.tripo3d.ai)
- IndexedDB database `bib`, store `img`: keys `<ID>|front0` (original front), `|front`, `|left`, `|right`, `|back`. Fix attempts are saved as `|left2` / `|right2` so originals are kept.
- localStorage: `bib_queue` (array of `[id, promptCore, rigFlag]`), `bib_state` (per-id `s`: front / mv / done / fail), `bib_scores` (per-id `{n, note, redo}`), `bib_flags` (second-pass review flags), `bib_runner`, `bib_helpers`, `bib_sheet`, `bib_review` (runner source, eval after a page reload), `bib_owner`, `bib_redo`.
- Nothing has been exported to disk yet except the CHR-0001 pilot images in `docs/Assets/Exports/work/`.

### Current blocker
- **Tripo rate limit.** `POST https://api.tripo3d.ai/v2/studio/image/gen_image_v2` returns **HTTP 429** (seen in the console and a fetch hook). It started at about 17:23 AEST after about 460 sets at 12 jobs at once. Probes at 17:44, 18:00 and 18:02 still returned 429. The owner believes it is an abuse cooldown.
- When limited, the Generate button looks enabled but no card appears, and multiview cards show "Generation failed. Your credits will be refunded automatically."
- Nothing is running now: the runner and the paced supervisor are both stopped. No CAPTCHA was shown, and none may be bypassed.

### How to resume (next session)
1. Open the generate-image page in the built-in browser. Check it is signed in and the header balance reads **89930**. Close any promo popup.
2. Re-load the code: `eval(localStorage.bib_runner); eval(localStorage.bib_review); eval(localStorage.bib_helpers); eval(localStorage.bib_sheet)`. Then wrap `window.fetch` to log `gen_image` responses (the hook `window.__f429` is lost on reload).
3. Probe **once**. If 429, wait at least 30 minutes before the next single probe and back off further. Never loop retries.
4. When it works, run **one set at a time** with random 75-150 s gaps. On any 429 or "no new card", stop and back off (30 min, then up to 1 h). Restart the runner after editing the queue, because it reads the queue only at start. Clear `front`/`mv`/`fail` states before a restart so they retry.
5. Order: the split entries and redos are at the front of the queue, then the remaining ~1,750 entries.
6. **Exact-angle fix (planned, untested):** for each flagged or new set, generate Left and Right as separate GPT Image 2.5 images using `front0` as the reference image, with a prompt asking for an orthographic side view at exactly 90° and a strict profile with no three-quarter turn, facing image-left (Left) or image-right (Right). Save as `|left2` / `|right2`, then review. The first test (PRP-0008 left) hit the 429.
7. **Review method:** draw a sheet of 4 or 9 sets on a canvas, trigger a PNG download (it lands as a hidden `~/Downloads/.Q6L2SF6YDW.com.anthropic.claudefordesktop.*` file), copy it to a scratch folder and view it. In-pane screenshots of an overlay also work while the pane is visible, but freeze when the pane is hidden. Score with `__bib.score(id, n, note)`; queue a regeneration with `__bib.redoEntry(id, extraPromptText, reason)`.
8. Keep `TRIPO_LEDGER.md` and this section current.

## Recommended production settings and polygon targets — 2026-10-11

**Status: WORKING technical recommendations.** Every one of the 2,673 asset entries below now has settings, a polygon target and production notes. Names, category, priority, story references, variations, prompts and catalogue status are unchanged. These are starting recommendations, not verified generated assets or measured device budgets.

- **Tripo meshes:** use existing approved references when available; otherwise retain the listed prompt. Review the base with Build & Refine, then retopologize and texture. Standard-detail/high-detail describe desired fidelity, not guaranteed UI preset names. Use the closest available quality option. Set Polygon Count to the listed face count; check the result after export.
- **Count units:** a listed quad target is a source mesh budget; approximately two runtime triangles per quad. Set the quad target, not its triangle estimate. Triangles are the runtime unit for rigid meshes. Targets are LOD0 per object/member/module/carriage, never an entire crowd/location unless explicitly stated. Mixed topology can alter the conversion.
- **Textures/materials:** 1K/2K/4K mean 1024/2048/4096 pixels per map. Use the closest available texture-generation option and resize/bake for delivery. Use de-lighting/Remove Lighting where offered; PBR maps are material inputs, with the owner's look applied in Unreal. Flat grey variants have no generated textures. Keep generation private where available.
- **Variations:** each listed variation inherits the asset's target. Pose, damage decals, lighting, weather, text and material changes normally reuse the base mesh. A distinct geometry/phase variant uses the same per-asset allowance and requires its own QA. Group variants multiply the per-member count by visible instances. Costume allocations are included in the whole character budget; split parts do not each receive the full character allowance.
- **Non-mesh entries:** audio, UI, lighting, weather and procedural effects have no Tripo Polygon Count. “N/A” means not applicable. Optional cards/proxies have an explicit per-card/per-proxy allowance; these are not whole-effect limits. Profile particle count, transparency, draw calls, audio and lights separately.
- **LOD/platform delivery:** begin with LOD1 about 50% and LOD2 about 25% of LOD0 triangles, preserving important silhouettes. Consider 2K instead of 4K maps on mobile and 1K for small props. Profile skinning, visible instances, materials and texture memory on target devices before treating any target as final.
- **Existing owner-directed generation:** earlier character-part H3.1/Ultra/8K/Quad 40,000 settings remain specific to that workflow. This catalogue update does not change those instructions or authorize generation, retries or spending. Open story/design decisions remain open.

Tripo control names were checked against the [official Studio tutorial](https://www.tripo3d.ai/blog/tripo-studio-tutorial-english) and [official model documentation](https://developers.tripo3d.ai/en/docs/generation-image-to-model) on 2026-10-11. Numeric budgets are recommendations from this asset review. Current options in the owner's Studio session are unverified.
